title: The Last Ember Anew
author: Noor Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Nystrom, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
